ODE 2: Events, Stiffness and Gradients¶

Three things come up as soon as an ODE solve is part of a larger problem: you want to stop when something happens, the system is stiff and ordinary steps are hopelessly small, or you need the derivative of the result with respect to the initial state or a parameter. After this chapter you can do all three.

Every program is complete and its output is the output of that program.

Programs¶

  • Stopping at an event

  • A stiff linear system

  • Gradients through a solve

Checklist¶

  1. Events: set direction, then check triggered before using y_final.

  2. Stiff linear systems: fluxa_linear with an action callable; the default explicit methods will need very many steps.

  3. Gradients: fluxa_adjoint, fixed-step RK4, enough steps for the gradient accuracy you need.

  4. Pass theta as a Series whenever you want its gradient.
